about_the_game:
FEATURES

  • Interact the game world using point and click interface with optional on screen direction pads and full keyboard support

  • Choose from 6 different main characters with unique abilities, skill bonuses and clothes

  • Explore a small island comprises of 9 distinct districts with 49 enterable buildings

  • Carry out main quests for Path A playthrough within Act 1, 2A and 3A for Rudolfo, Anna, Chris, Phill, Hong Mi, Bruce, Priscilla and Father Oliver

  • Carry out main quests for Path B playthrough within Act 1 and 2B for Rudolfo, Anna, Nolan and Lady Junk

  • Carry out side quests for Rudolfo, Prenny, Hugo, Salma and Alli

  • Unlock optional secret mode to remove fugitive status bypassing main quests

  • Take part-time jobs at the restaurants to earn side income

  • Talk to 200+ generic characters and have a chance to trade something with them

  • Go fishing at 9 different fishing spots throughout the island and sell the catch to the chef at sushi restaurant for some money

  • Scavenge trash cans all over the island to recycle scrap and sell the scrap at the back of pawn shop for some money

  • Forage tree stumps for mushrooms

  • Attend 20 different classes offered by 4 schools to gain skill experience points

  • Rent flat, apartment or condominium unit as home and upgrade it with up to 20 furniture option (if secret mode is unlocked or fugitive problem has been solved)

  • Get hired and grow career in ad agency, law firm, modelling agency or fashion firm (if secret mode is unlocked or fugitive problem has been solved)

  • Cook food with 66 recipes which can be learned by taking part-time job at the restaurants or watching cooking show on TV

  • Buy food ingredients from hypermarket, 24 hours shop, cake & pastry shop or night market stalls

  • Use taxi at bus stops to move between buildings (fast travel)

  • Use free bus at bus stops to move between districts

  • Buy scooter and cars as vehicle

  • Invest in jewellery and company stocks

  • Upgrade street credential to unlock more clothes and enemies

  • Claim free daily random or special event vouchers from counters

name: Dream City Fugitive

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 120 MB available space

short_description: Dream City Fugitive is an open world combat focused urban role playing game. You're a fugitive on the run. Join a vigilante group to investigate horrible experiments and dealing with gang warfare on a small island, Dream City. Otherwise, pursue the path of a cult in their vision of dark salvation.
